linked.title: Use Mail and Packages settings
linked.description: Select an existing Mail and Packages account. Travel Tracker will reuse its saved credentials without copying them into its own configuration, but it still opens a separate read-only IMAP connection. Leave Folder override blank to scan the Mail and Packages folder.

imap.title: Connect a separate IMAP mailbox
imap.description: Create an independent read-only travel mailbox connection.
